What happens what the head passes through n times?

↪️x1 > 11
↪️x1 < 21
↪️x2 03 >

11 <
↪️x1 > 22
↪️x1 01 >

01 <
11 >

----

03 ↪️xn
↪️x(2n) 03 >

11 ↪️x2
↪️x1 01 ↪️x1
↪️x1 11 >

11 ↪️x(2n)
↪️xn 11 >

11 ↪️x(2n+1)
↪️x(n+1) 01 >

01 ↪️x2
11 ↪️x1
↪️x1 01 >

01 ↪️x(2n)
↪️xn 01 >

01 ↪️x(2n+1)
↪️xn 11 >

03 ↪️xn
↪️x(2n) 03 >

↪️xn 11 >

11 ↪️x(2n+1)
↪️x(n+1) 01 >

01 ↪️x(2n)
↪️xn 01 >

01 ↪️x(2n+1)
↪️xn 11 >
